highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 with native GTK4 GPU rendering.
highlights_body: GTK4 gains a GL-backed canvas and high-density raster backing, while Linux NoDependencies restores system-font discovery. This preview also updates WebAssembly archive selection for .NET 11 and raises the Tizen baseline.

breaking.title: GTK4 raster painting defaults to physical pixels
breaking.body: SKDrawingArea now allocates high-density backing storage and reports physical pixels through CanvasSize and paint Info. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true to paint in logical coordinates while retaining full backing resolution; RawInfo remains physical and GTK input coordinates remain logical.

breaking.title: Tizen native packages require Tizen 10
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp Tizen native packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and support x64 and arm64. Upgrade applications to Tizen 10; these native builds no longer support Tizen 8 or 9. Native source builds require GCC 14.2.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 156 without changing managed API or generated binding declarations. HarfBuzzSharp advances to package revision 14.4.0.100 while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, a view-owned GRContext, optional render loop, and logical-coordinate painting through IgnorePixelScaling. GTK owns the GL context; manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy.

bullets.lead: Linux NoDependencies finds installed fonts again
bullets.detail: Restores directory-backed default font discovery without requiring fontconfig. The default scan uses /usr/share/fonts, enabling family lookup and avoiding SKShaper construction failures when suitable fonts are installed.
Disposes the Skia surface before its Cairo-owned pixels and marks swizzled pixel storage dirty after modification.
SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp select Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for net11 and later, including threading and SIMD variants. Existing net8 and net9/net10 mappings remain 3.1.34 and 3.1.56 respectively.

Aligns the selected v143 compiler with its Spectre CRT, enables MSBuild Spectre mitigation for HarfBuzz and native WinUI, and propagates CFG and stack-cookie flags through ANGLE and eligible third-party code. Spectre CRT provenance does not imply whole-program mitigation.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux NoDependencies system-font discovery without adding fontconfig

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 introduces Skia m156, native GTK4 GPU rendering, restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, and .NET 11 WebAssembly archive selection. Tizen packages now require Tizen 10.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates .NET 11 and later WebAssembly archive selection to Emscripten 6.0.2, raises Tizen packages to Tizen 10, and aligns Windows builds with the selected v143 compiler and Spectre CRT. The package revision is 14.4.0.100; native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 and native GTK4 GPU rendering.
v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.body: Restores Linux NoDependencies system-font discovery and selects matching WebAssembly archives for .NET 11. GTK4 raster painting now defaults to physical pixels, and Tizen native packages require Tizen 10.
